name: SocialSphere
elevator: We are building a social web app that enables users to share content, engage in real-time interactions, and build communities around shared interests. Our platform offers user-friendly content posting, personalized feeds, and robust admin moderation tools.
description: Social web app for posting, sharing, and interacting with content.

current_prd.elevator_pitch: Social web app for posting, sharing, and interacting with content.
current_prd.problem_statement: Users lack a seamless platform for sharing content, engaging in real-time interactions, and building communities around shared interests.
current_prd.solution: A social web app featuring user authentication, content posting, real-time interactions, personalized feeds, and admin moderation tools.

key_features.feature_description: Secure registration and login using email or social accounts
Personalized profiles with bio, avatar, and settings
Users can post text and images
Like and comment on posts in real-time
Customized timeline of followed users' content
Continuous loading of content as the user scrolls
Moderate content, manage users, and view analytics

current_prd.success_metrics: User engagement (daily/monthly active users), content creation rate, like/comment rate, user retention, and admin moderation efficiency.
current_prd.vision: To become the leading social platform for fostering meaningful connections and empowering users to share their unique perspectives with the world.

target_audience.name: Social Media Users
target_audience.pain_points: Information overload, privacy concerns, irrelevant content
target_audience.needs_and_goals: Connect with friends, share updates, discover content, engage in discussions

phasing.rationale: This phase includes the core features required for users to sign up, create profiles, post content, interact with other users' content, follow other users, and view a personalized feed. This is the minimum set of features required for a functional social media platform.
This phase focuses on improving the user experience with infinite scroll, allowing for continuous content discovery.
This phase adds the admin dashboard, which is essential for content moderation, user management, and platform analytics. This is crucial for maintaining a healthy and safe community.

current_prd.design_principles: Real-time updates, responsiveness, intuitive user interface, scalability, and security.

current_prd.navigation_design: The app uses a bottom navigation bar for quick access to the Home feed, Profile, Search, and Notifications. The Admin Dashboard is accessible through a separate login and uses a sidebar navigation for Content Moderation, User Management, and Analytics.
current_prd.schema: The data model includes tables for users, posts, likes, comments, follows, and admin users. The User table stores user information. The Post table stores user-generated content. The Like table tracks which users liked which posts. The Comment table stores comments on posts. The Follow table manages follow relationships between users. The AdminUser table stores admin user credentials.

user_stories.title: User Registration with Email

user_story.i_want: to register with my email address
user_story.so_that: I can create an account and access the platform

acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the registration page, when I enter a valid email, password, and confirm password, then I should be able to create an account
Given I am on the registration page, when I enter an invalid email format, then I should see an error message
Given I am on the registration page, when the passwords do not match, then I should see an error message
Given I am on the registration page, when I enter an email that already exists, then I should see an error message

user_stories.title: User Login with Email

user_story.i_want: to log in with my email and password
user_story.so_that: I can access my account and personalized content

acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the login page, when I enter valid email and password, then I should be logged in and redirected to my feed
Given I am on the login page, when I enter an invalid email or password, then I should see an error message
Given I am on the login page, when I enter an email that does not exist, then I should see an error message

user_stories.title: User Profile Management

user_story.i_want: to manage my profile information (bio, avatar, settings)
user_story.so_that: I can personalize my profile and control my account settings

acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, when I navigate to the profile settings page, then I should be able to update my bio, avatar, and other settings
Given I update my bio, then the updated bio should be visible on my profile
Given I upload a new avatar, then the new avatar should be displayed on my profile
Given I change my settings (e.g., privacy settings), then the changes should be saved and applied to my account

user_stories.title: Post Text Content

user_story.so_that: I can share my thoughts and updates with my followers

acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, when I navigate to the posting area, then I should be able to enter text content and post it to my feed
Given I post text content, then the post should be visible on my feed and the feeds of my followers
Given I post text content, then the post should include a timestamp

user_stories.title: Post Image Content

user_story.so_that: I can share visual content with my followers

acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, when I navigate to the posting area, then I should be able to upload an image and post it to my feed
Given I post an image, then the image should be visible on my feed and the feeds of my followers
Given I post an image, then the post should include a timestamp

user_stories.title: Like a Post

user_story.so_that: I can show my appreciation for the content

acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing a post, when I click the like button, then the like count should increase
Given I have liked a post, when I click the like button again, then the like should be removed and the like count should decrease
Given I like a post, then the author of the post should be notified

user_stories.title: Comment on a Post

user_story.so_that: I can share my thoughts and engage in discussions

acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing a post, when I enter a comment and submit it, then the comment should be visible below the post
Given I comment on a post, then the author of the post and other commenters should be notified

user_stories.title: Follow a User

user_story.so_that: I can see their content in my personalized feed

acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing a user's profile, when I click the follow button, then I should start following the user
Given I am following a user, then their posts should appear in my feed
Given I follow a user, then the user should be notified

user_stories.title: Unfollow a User

user_story.so_that: I can remove their content from my personalized feed

acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing a user's profile, when I click the unfollow button, then I should stop following the user
Given I unfollow a user, then their posts should no longer appear in my feed

user_stories.title: View Personalized Feed

user_story.i_want: to view a personalized feed of content from users I follow
user_story.so_that: I can stay updated on the content that interests me

acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, when I navigate to the home feed, then I should see a timeline of posts from users I follow
Given I follow a user, then their new posts should appear in my feed in real-time
Given I unfollow a user, then their posts should no longer appear in my feed

user_stories.title: Real-time Updates

user_story.i_want: to see real-time updates for posts, comments, and likes
user_story.so_that: I can have a seamless and engaging experience

acceptance_criteria: Given a new post is created by a user I follow, when the post is created, then it should appear in my feed without requiring a page reload
Given someone likes or comments on my post, when the action occurs, then I should see the update in real-time without requiring a page reload

user_stories.title: Infinite Scroll

user_story.so_that: I can continuously browse content without pagination

acceptance_criteria: Given I am scrolling through my feed, when I reach the bottom of the page, then more content should automatically load without requiring me to click a button or navigate to another page

user_stories.title: Admin Content Moderation

user_story.so_that: I can ensure the platform is free of inappropriate or harmful content

acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in as an admin, when I navigate to the content moderation dashboard, then I should be able to view and remove posts or comments that violate the platform's guidelines
Given I remove a post or comment, then it should be immediately removed from the platform and no longer visible to users

user_stories.title: Admin User Management

user_story.so_that: I can maintain a healthy user base and address any issues

acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in as an admin, when I navigate to the user management dashboard, then I should be able to view, edit, and ban users
Given I ban a user, then they should be unable to log in to the platform

user_stories.title: Admin View Analytics

user_story.so_that: I can track platform usage and identify areas for improvement

acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in as an admin, when I navigate to the analytics dashboard, then I should be able to see key metrics such as daily active users, post engagement, and user growth

planned.model_content:
class Post < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :user
  belongs_to :organization

  has_many :likes, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :comments, dependent: :destroy

  has_one_attached :image

  validates :content, presence: true

  rhino_owner :organization
  rhino_references [:user, :organization]
end

      t.references :organization, null: false, foreign_key: true

      t.timestamps
    end
  end
end

planned.model_content:
class Follow < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :follower, class_name: 'User'
  belongs_to :followed_user, class_name: 'User'
  belongs_to :organization

  validates :follower_id, uniqueness: { scope: :followed_user_id }
  validate :cannot_follow_self

  def cannot_follow_self
    if follower_id == followed_user_id
      errors.add(:base, "User cannot follow themselves")
    end
  end

  rhino_owner :organization
  rhino_references [:follower, :followed_user, :organization]
end
planned.migration_content:
class CreateFollows < ActiveRecord::Migration[7.2]
  def change
    create_table :follows do |t|
      t.references :follower, null: false, foreign_key: { to_table: :users }
      t.references :followed_user, null: false, foreign_key: { to_table: :users }
      t.references :organization, null: false, foreign_key: true

      t.timestamps
    end
    add_index :follows, [:follower_id, :followed_user_id], unique: true
  end
end
